apps.name: MangaView
apps.subtitle: Manga/webtoon reader (MVP)
apps.localizedDescription: Unofficial reader for a manga/webtoon mirror site family. No address is bundled - you enter a mirror URL on first run. Home browsing, title search with filters, favorites, recently read, episode list, and both a native and a WebView reader.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds advanced search filters (author, tag, publication, initial, weekday, platform, sort), a favorites screen, a recently-read list, a navigation drawer, a native image viewer alongside the WebView reader, and a captcha screen for when the mirror challenges a request. Fixes thumbnail loading and the Toki31 mirror's webtoon listing 404. Known issue: cover art and reader images may fail to load on networks that SNI-filter the site's CDN; still never run on a real iOS device.

Reader top bar no longer overlaps the status bar and now slides fully out of sight on scroll. Home/search cards no longer overflow their grid cell on a two-line title. Known issue: cover art and reader images may fail to load on networks that SNI-filter the site's CDN; never run on a real iOS device yet.
